Here you can find a series of Yoga Classes. Anyone can perform this routine at home with a minimum amount of equipment.

Among other asanas in the class you will find: 

Utthita parsva konasa (extended side angle pose) and triangle pose with bind, skandasana (side lunge) Utthita hasta Padangustasana B Malasana, (squat pose with adductor stretch) titibasana, Prasaritta Padottanasana C.

The classes are always starting with pre-warm-up and sun salutations and always ending with a little meditation nadi shodana and kapalabathi.

programs.Title: Body Sculpting Pilates Series
programs.Description1: Welcome to my Body Sculpting Pilates with Props Series. With the help of this video series, you will learn to work out alone adapt and modify the exercises for yourself according to your current needs. You will learn how to progress or regress the level of some exercises and how to modify them. You will also understand the basics and alignments of Pilates. The program is suitable for any age, body type and you can join from any level.
programs.Description2:
If you would to have a guided workout for Pilates then this program is for you!
 - How to modify exercises to your own level
 - How to perform variations and modifications to exercises so they became easier or harder for you, according to your actual needs
 - Learn how to work out by your own: without props, with long elastic, with short elastic and with water bottles
 - Understand the basics of Pilates the correct alignments and the correct breathing.
programs.Description3:
The program includes:
 - Essentials about Pilates
 - 12 video workouts of 30min from beginner to advance
 - How to workout without props, elastics, and water bottles
 - Bonus track: 30min Intermediate and Advance Pilates Classes

programs.MainDescription: Set of videos with detailed explanations on how to achieve deep backbends through tutorials, classes, and drills.
programs.Title: Backbends Series
programs.Description1: This program is for those who are looking to increase back flexibility and achieve a beautiful backbend. Multiply your back flexibility and achieve postures such as bow pose with the legs at your head, king pigeon pose, and bhujangasana. Here I provide detailed explanations that will help you to deblock your tight areas and open your muscles to achieve those postures.
programs.Description2:
If you would like to get beautiful deep and balanced backbends then this program is for you!
 - Lose the fears of changing your grip
 - Have a beautifully balanced extension
 - Get your legs to your head or close to your head in pigeon, bow, and in royal cobra
 - Get a nice balanced arch in backbends and arrive to drop backbend
 - Lose the fear of falling in drop backbend
With this program I will help you to improve:
 - The flexibility of your upper back
 - The flexibility of your lower back
 - The flexibility of your hip flexors
 - Strengthen your back
 - Mobilize your shoulders
 - Hip flexibility and mobility
programs.Description3:
The program includes:
 - Understand better how the backbends function
 - Prewarm up, sun salutations, sequenced classes, drills for achieving better skills, closing sequences, meditation
 - Grip flip with king pigeon pose, bow pose and tiger pose, bhujangasana.
 - Build up and establish a solid and safe home practice
 - How to use the wall and props to adjust yourself
 - Bonus tracks: Split class and drop backbend preparation tutorials
